fusions.name: Scattered Embers
fusions.desc: Splits the target for 13 fire damage, sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Scorched Palms
fusions.desc: A swing of the heated axe that deals 8 fire damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you and sets each target [Burning] for 4 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Burning Deadfall
fusions.desc: Fells a burning log 5 tiles long in front of you for 6 seconds. It deals 4 fire damage to anything that crosses it and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Smith-Quenched Blade
fusions.desc: Conjures a forge-hot axe. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. You have 8% fire resistance.
